modelMetrics.name: processed_bar_count
modelMetrics.label: Processed bars
modelMetrics.definition: Test bars the model made a call on in this scope.

modelMetrics.name: scored_bar_count
modelMetrics.label: Scored bars
modelMetrics.definition: Bars whose outcome is known and counted: the move over the label horizon beat the label threshold, the horizon crossed no session gap, and the model made a call.
modelMetrics.formula: count of bars with a known up/down outcome and a prediction

modelMetrics.name: unscored_bar_count
modelMetrics.label: Unscored bars
modelMetrics.definition: Processed bars left out of the classification metrics: the move stayed inside the label threshold, the horizon crossed a session gap, or the horizon ran past the data.

modelMetrics.name: coverage_fraction
modelMetrics.label: Coverage
modelMetrics.definition: The share of processed bars that were scored.

modelMetrics.name: gap_crossing_bar_count
modelMetrics.label: Gap-crossing bars
modelMetrics.definition: Bars whose label horizon crossed a session gap, so they carry no label, target or forecast.
modelMetrics.formula: count of bars with crosses_gap true

modelMetrics.name: actual_up_fraction
modelMetrics.label: Actual up share
modelMetrics.definition: The share of scored bars whose price rose over the horizon: the base rate a classifier has to beat.
modelMetrics.formula: scored bars that went up / scored bars

modelMetrics.name: predicted_up_fraction
modelMetrics.label: Predicted up share
modelMetrics.definition: The share of scored bars the model called up.
modelMetrics.formula: scored bars called up / scored bars

modelMetrics.name: accuracy
modelMetrics.label: Accuracy
modelMetrics.definition: The share of scored bars whose direction the model called correctly.

modelMetrics.name: balanced_accuracy
modelMetrics.label: Balanced accuracy
modelMetrics.definition: Accuracy with up and down weighted equally, so a lopsided market cannot flatter it.

modelMetrics.name: precision
modelMetrics.label: Precision (up)
modelMetrics.definition: Of the bars called up, the share that went up.
modelMetrics.formula: true up calls / all up calls

modelMetrics.name: recall
modelMetrics.label: Recall (up)
modelMetrics.definition: Of the bars that went up, the share the model called up.
modelMetrics.formula: true up calls / bars that went up

modelMetrics.name: f1_score
modelMetrics.label: F1 score (up)
modelMetrics.definition: The harmonic mean of precision and recall for the up class.

modelMetrics.name: precision_down
modelMetrics.label: Precision (down)
modelMetrics.definition: Of the bars called down, the share that went down.
modelMetrics.formula: true down calls / all down calls

modelMetrics.name: recall_down
modelMetrics.label: Recall (down)
modelMetrics.definition: Of the bars that went down, the share the model called down (the specificity).
modelMetrics.formula: true down calls / bars that went down

modelMetrics.name: f1_score_down
modelMetrics.label: F1 score (down)
modelMetrics.definition: The harmonic mean of precision and recall for the down class.
modelMetrics.formula: 2 x true down / (2 x true down + false down calls + missed downs)

modelMetrics.name: macro_f1_score
modelMetrics.label: Macro F1 score
modelMetrics.definition: The F1 score of up and of down, averaged.

modelMetrics.name: matthews_correlation_coefficient
modelMetrics.label: Matthews correlation
modelMetrics.definition: The correlation between the calls and the outcomes, from -1 (always wrong) through 0 (no better than chance) to 1; fair under imbalance.
modelMetrics.formula: (TP x TN - FP x FN) / sqrt((TP + FP)(TP + FN)(TN + FP)(TN + FN))

modelMetrics.name: cohens_kappa
modelMetrics.label: Cohen's kappa
modelMetrics.definition: Agreement between calls and outcomes beyond what the two base rates would give by chance.

modelMetrics.name: roc_auc
modelMetrics.label: ROC AUC
modelMetrics.definition: The chance that a randomly chosen up bar got a higher P(up) than a randomly chosen down bar; 0.5 is no ranking skill.
modelMetrics.formula: area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of P(up)

modelMetrics.name: average_precision
modelMetrics.label: Average precision (PR AUC)
modelMetrics.definition: The area under the precision-recall curve of P(up): ranking skill for the up class, read against the up base rate.
modelMetrics.formula: sum over thresholds of (recall step x precision)

modelMetrics.name: true_positive_count
modelMetrics.label: Up called up
modelMetrics.definition: Bars called up that went up.

modelMetrics.name: false_positive_count
modelMetrics.label: Down called up
modelMetrics.definition: Bars called up that went down.

modelMetrics.name: true_negative_count
modelMetrics.label: Down called down
modelMetrics.definition: Bars called down that went down.

modelMetrics.name: false_negative_count
modelMetrics.label: Up called down
modelMetrics.definition: Bars called down that went up.

modelMetrics.name: log_loss
modelMetrics.label: Log loss
modelMetrics.definition: How surprised the model was by what happened, averaged; punishes confident wrong calls hard. 0.693 is a coin flip.

modelMetrics.name: brier_score
modelMetrics.label: Brier score
modelMetrics.definition: The mean squared gap between P(up) and the outcome (1 up, 0 down); 0.25 is always saying 0.5.

modelMetrics.name: brier_skill_score
modelMetrics.label: Brier skill score
modelMetrics.definition: How much better the Brier score is than always forecasting the base rate; above 0 beats the base rate.
modelMetrics.formula: 1 - Brier score / (base rate x (1 - base rate))

modelMetrics.name: mean_probability_up
modelMetrics.label: Mean P(up)
modelMetrics.definition: The average probability of up the model gave on scored bars.

modelMetrics.name: probability_up_sharpness
modelMetrics.label: Sharpness
modelMetrics.definition: How far the model's probabilities spread: the standard deviation of P(up). Sharp is only good when it is also calibrated.

modelMetrics.name: expected_calibration_error
modelMetrics.label: Expected calibration error
modelMetrics.definition: The average gap between the probability forecast and how often up happened, over ten equal-width probability bins weighted by their bar counts.
modelMetrics.formula: sum over bins of (bars in bin / scored bars) x |observed up share - mean p|

modelMetrics.name: maximum_calibration_error
modelMetrics.label: Maximum calibration error
modelMetrics.definition: The largest such gap in any non-empty bin.
modelMetrics.formula: max over bins of |observed up share - mean p|

modelMetrics.name: brier_reliability_component
modelMetrics.label: Brier reliability
modelMetrics.definition: The part of the Brier score that is miscalibration (Murphy 1973, ten equal-width bins).
modelMetrics.formula: sum over bins of n_k (mean p_k - observed_k)^2 / N

modelMetrics.name: brier_resolution_component
modelMetrics.label: Brier resolution
modelMetrics.definition: The part of the Brier score that is separation: how far each bin's outcome rate sits from the base rate (Murphy 1973).
modelMetrics.formula: sum over bins of n_k (observed_k - base rate)^2 / N

modelMetrics.name: brier_uncertainty_component
modelMetrics.label: Brier uncertainty
modelMetrics.definition: The Brier score of always forecasting the base rate; a property of the data, not the model. Brier = reliability - resolution + uncertainty, up to the spread of p inside each bin.

modelMetrics.formula: scored bars matching the fold's training majority / scored bars

modelMetrics.definition: The accuracy of calling every scored bar up.
modelMetrics.formula: scored bars that went up / scored bars

modelMetrics.name: accuracy_lift_over_majority_class
modelMetrics.label: Accuracy over majority class
modelMetrics.definition: How much the model's accuracy beats the majority-class baseline, in accuracy points.

modelMetrics.name: resolved_forecast_count
modelMetrics.label: Resolved forecasts
modelMetrics.definition: Price forecasts whose target bar has been walked, so their error is known.
modelMetrics.formula: count of bars with a forecast error

modelMetrics.name: price_forecast_mean_absolute_error_points

modelMetrics.name: persistence_mean_absolute_error_points
modelMetrics.label: No-change mean absolute error

modelMetrics.name: price_forecast_skill
modelMetrics.label: Forecast skill versus no-change
modelMetrics.definition: How much smaller the forecast's error is than the no-change forecast's; above 0 beats no-change.
modelMetrics.formula: 1 - forecast mean absolute error / no-change mean absolute error

modelMetrics.name: price_forecast_root_mean_square_error_points

modelMetrics.name: processed_bar_count

modelMetrics.name: scored_bar_count

modelMetrics.name: unscored_bar_count
modelMetrics.label: Unscored bars

modelMetrics.name: coverage_fraction
modelMetrics.label: Coverage
modelMetrics.definition: The share of processed bars that were scored.

modelMetrics.name: gap_crossing_bar_count
modelMetrics.label: Gap-crossing bars
modelMetrics.definition: Bars whose label horizon crossed a session gap, so they carry no label, target or forecast.
modelMetrics.formula: count of bars with crosses_gap true

modelMetrics.name: actual_up_fraction
modelMetrics.label: Actual up share
modelMetrics.definition: The share of scored bars whose price rose over the horizon: the base rate a classifier has to beat.
modelMetrics.formula: scored bars that went up / scored bars

modelMetrics.name: predicted_up_fraction
modelMetrics.label: Predicted up share
modelMetrics.definition: The share of scored bars the model called up.
modelMetrics.formula: scored bars called up / scored bars

modelMetrics.name: accuracy
modelMetrics.label: Accuracy
modelMetrics.definition: The share of scored bars whose direction the model called correctly.

modelMetrics.name: balanced_accuracy
modelMetrics.label: Balanced accuracy
modelMetrics.definition: Accuracy with up and down weighted equally, so a lopsided market cannot flatter it.

modelMetrics.name: precision
modelMetrics.label: Precision (up)
modelMetrics.definition: Of the bars called up, the share that went up.
modelMetrics.formula: true up calls / all up calls

modelMetrics.name: recall
modelMetrics.label: Recall (up)
modelMetrics.definition: Of the bars that went up, the share the model called up.
modelMetrics.formula: true up calls / bars that went up

modelMetrics.name: f1_score
modelMetrics.label: F1 score (up)
modelMetrics.definition: The harmonic mean of precision and recall for the up class.

modelMetrics.name: precision_down
modelMetrics.label: Precision (down)
modelMetrics.definition: Of the bars called down, the share that went down.
modelMetrics.formula: true down calls / all down calls

modelMetrics.name: recall_down
modelMetrics.label: Recall (down)
modelMetrics.definition: Of the bars that went down, the share the model called down (the specificity).
modelMetrics.formula: true down calls / bars that went down

modelMetrics.name: f1_score_down
modelMetrics.label: F1 score (down)
modelMetrics.definition: The harmonic mean of precision and recall for the down class.
modelMetrics.formula: 2 x true down / (2 x true down + false down calls + missed downs)

modelMetrics.name: macro_f1_score
modelMetrics.label: Macro F1 score
modelMetrics.definition: The F1 score of up and of down, averaged.

modelMetrics.name: matthews_correlation_coefficient
modelMetrics.label: Matthews correlation
modelMetrics.definition: The correlation between the calls and the outcomes, from -1 (always wrong) through 0 (no better than chance) to 1; fair under imbalance.
modelMetrics.formula: (TP x TN - FP x FN) / sqrt((TP + FP)(TP + FN)(TN + FP)(TN + FN))

modelMetrics.name: cohens_kappa
modelMetrics.label: Cohen's kappa
modelMetrics.definition: Agreement between calls and outcomes beyond what the two base rates would give by chance.

modelMetrics.name: roc_auc
modelMetrics.label: ROC AUC
modelMetrics.definition: The chance that a randomly chosen up bar got a higher P(up) than a randomly chosen down bar; 0.5 is no ranking skill.
modelMetrics.formula: area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of P(up)

modelMetrics.name: average_precision
modelMetrics.label: Average precision (PR AUC)
modelMetrics.definition: The area under the precision-recall curve of P(up): ranking skill for the up class, read against the up base rate.
modelMetrics.formula: sum over thresholds of (recall step x precision)

modelMetrics.label: Down called up

modelMetrics.label: Brier skill score

modelMetrics.name: mean_probability_up
modelMetrics.label: Mean P(up)
modelMetrics.definition: The average probability of up the model gave on scored bars.

modelMetrics.name: probability_up_sharpness
modelMetrics.label: Sharpness
modelMetrics.definition: How far the model's probabilities spread: the standard deviation of P(up). Sharp is only good when it is also calibrated.

modelMetrics.name: expected_calibration_error
modelMetrics.label: Expected calibration error
modelMetrics.definition: The average gap between the probability forecast and how often up happened, over ten equal-width probability bins weighted by their bar counts.
modelMetrics.formula: sum over bins of (bars in bin / scored bars) x |observed up share - mean p|

modelMetrics.name: maximum_calibration_error
modelMetrics.label: Maximum calibration error
modelMetrics.definition: The largest such gap in any non-empty bin.
modelMetrics.formula: max over bins of |observed up share - mean p|

modelMetrics.name: brier_reliability_component
modelMetrics.label: Brier reliability
modelMetrics.definition: The part of the Brier score that is miscalibration (Murphy 1973, ten equal-width bins).
modelMetrics.formula: sum over bins of n_k (mean p_k - observed_k)^2 / N

modelMetrics.name: brier_resolution_component
modelMetrics.label: Brier resolution
modelMetrics.definition: The part of the Brier score that is separation: how far each bin's outcome rate sits from the base rate (Murphy 1973).
modelMetrics.formula: sum over bins of n_k (observed_k - base rate)^2 / N

modelMetrics.name: brier_uncertainty_component
modelMetrics.label: Brier uncertainty
modelMetrics.definition: The Brier score of always forecasting the base rate; a property of the data, not the model. Brier = reliability - resolution + uncertainty, up to the spread of p inside each bin.

modelMetrics.name: majority_class_accuracy
modelMetrics.label: Majority-class accuracy

modelMetrics.name: always_up_accuracy
modelMetrics.label: Always-up accuracy
modelMetrics.definition: The accuracy of calling every scored bar up.
modelMetrics.formula: scored bars that went up / scored bars

modelMetrics.name: accuracy_lift_over_majority_class
modelMetrics.label: Accuracy over majority class
modelMetrics.definition: How much the model's accuracy beats the majority-class baseline, in accuracy points.

modelMetrics.name: resolved_forecast_count
modelMetrics.label: Resolved forecasts
modelMetrics.definition: Price forecasts whose target bar has been walked, so their error is known.
modelMetrics.formula: count of bars with a forecast error

modelMetrics.name: price_forecast_mean_absolute_error_points
modelMetrics.label: Forecast mean absolute error
modelMetrics.definition: The average size of the gap between the forecast move and the actual move.

modelMetrics.name: persistence_mean_absolute_error_points
modelMetrics.label: No-change mean absolute error
modelMetrics.definition: The same error for the no-change forecast (predicted close = this close): the baseline.

modelMetrics.name: price_forecast_skill
modelMetrics.label: Forecast skill versus no-change

modelMetrics.name: price_forecast_root_mean_square_error_points

modelMetrics.name: price_forecast_direction_accuracy

modelMetrics.name: price_forecast_median_absolute_error_points

tradingMetrics.name: net_profit_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Net profit
tradingMetrics.definition: Profit after every cost, marked to market bar by bar.

tradingMetrics.name: net_profit_before_costs_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Net profit before costs
tradingMetrics.definition: What the calls earned before commissions, fees and slippage.

tradingMetrics.name: annualized_net_profit_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Annualized net profit
tradingMetrics.definition: The average bar's net profit scaled to a year of bars.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(per-bar net) x bars per year

tradingMetrics.name: net_profit_per_session_day_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Net profit per session day
tradingMetrics.definition: Net profit divided by the session days traded.

tradingMetrics.name: average_bar_net_profit_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Average bar net profit
tradingMetrics.definition: The mean net profit of one bar.

tradingMetrics.name: bar_count
tradingMetrics.label: Bars
tradingMetrics.definition: Bars marked to market in this scope.

tradingMetrics.name: session_day_count
tradingMetrics.label: Session days
tradingMetrics.definition: CME session days with at least one bar in this scope.

tradingMetrics.name: sharpe_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Sharpe ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Average per-bar profit over its standard deviation, annualized with the run's measured bars per year.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(r) / std(r, ddof 1) x sqrt(bars per year)

tradingMetrics.name: sortino_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Sortino ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Like Sharpe, but only losing bars count as risk.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(r) / sqrt(mean(min(r, 0)^2)) x sqrt(bars per year)

tradingMetrics.name: calmar_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Calmar ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Annualized profit over the worst drawdown.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(r) x bars per year / maximum drawdown

tradingMetrics.name: sharpe_ratio_standard_error
tradingMetrics.label: Sharpe ratio standard error
tradingMetrics.definition: How uncertain the Sharpe estimate is given the sample size and the skew and fat tails of per-bar profit (Lo 2002; Bailey and Lopez de Prado 2012).
tradingMetrics.formula: sqrt((1 - skew x SR + (kurtosis - 1) / 4 x SR^2) / (N - 1)) x sqrt(bars per year), SR per bar, kurtosis not excess

tradingMetrics.name: probabilistic_sharpe_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Probabilistic Sharpe ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: The probability that the true Sharpe ratio is above zero given this sample, its skew and its fat tails (Bailey and Lopez de Prado 2012).
tradingMetrics.formula: Phi(SR x sqrt(N - 1) / sqrt(1 - skew x SR + (kurtosis - 1) / 4 x SR^2)), SR per bar

tradingMetrics.name: session_day_sharpe_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Session-day Sharpe ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Sharpe computed on each session day's net profit, annualized with 252 sessions per year.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(day net) / std(day net, ddof 1) x sqrt(252)

tradingMetrics.name: tail_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Tail ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: The size of the 95th-percentile bar gain over the 5th-percentile bar loss; above 1 the right tail is fatter.
tradingMetrics.formula: |95th percentile of r| / |5th percentile of r|

tradingMetrics.name: common_sense_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Common sense ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Profit factor times tail ratio (Kestner): above 1 the edge survives its tails.

tradingMetrics.name: recovery_factor
tradingMetrics.label: Recovery factor
tradingMetrics.definition: Net profit over the worst drawdown: how many times the profit covers its deepest hole.

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Maximum drawdown
tradingMetrics.definition: The largest fall of the equity curve (starting at 0) from a peak to a later trough.
tradingMetrics.formula: max over bars of (running peak - equity)

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_duration_bars
tradingMetrics.label: Longest drawdown (bars)
tradingMetrics.definition: The longest stretch the equity spent below a previous peak, from the peak until it was regained or the scope ended.
tradingMetrics.formula: max over drawdown episodes of bars from peak to recovery

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_duration_days
tradingMetrics.label: Longest drawdown (days)
tradingMetrics.definition: The same stretch in calendar days.
tradingMetrics.formula: time from peak to recovery / 86,400 s

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_recovery_bars
tradingMetrics.label: Recovery from the maximum drawdown (bars)
tradingMetrics.note: the scope ended before the equity regained its peak
tradingMetrics.definition: Bars from the deepest trough back to the peak before it; null when the scope ended before the equity recovered.
tradingMetrics.formula: bars from trough to recovery of the deepest episode

tradingMetrics.name: average_drawdown_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Average drawdown
tradingMetrics.definition: The average depth below the running peak over the bars spent under water.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(running peak - equity) over bars below the peak

tradingMetrics.name: ulcer_index_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Ulcer index
tradingMetrics.definition: The root mean square depth below the running peak over every bar: depth and duration of pain together (Martin and McCann 1989, in USD).

tradingMetrics.name: drawdown_count
tradingMetrics.label: Drawdowns
tradingMetrics.definition: Distinct peak-to-trough-to-recovery episodes.

tradingMetrics.name: trade_count
tradingMetrics.label: Closed trades
tradingMetrics.definition: Trades opened and closed in this scope.

tradingMetrics.name: winning_trade_count
tradingMetrics.label: Winning trades
tradingMetrics.definition: Closed trades with a positive net.

tradingMetrics.name: losing_trade_count
tradingMetrics.label: Losing trades
tradingMetrics.definition: Closed trades with a negative net.

tradingMetrics.name: win_rate
tradingMetrics.label: Win rate
tradingMetrics.definition: The share of closed trades that made money after costs.

tradingMetrics.name: profit_factor
tradingMetrics.label: Profit factor
tradingMetrics.definition: What the winners made per dollar the losers lost; above 1 is profitable.
tradingMetrics.formula: sum of winning nets / |sum of losing nets|

tradingMetrics.name: payoff_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Payoff ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: The average winner's size over the average loser's.

tradingMetrics.name: expectancy_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Expectancy
tradingMetrics.definition: What a trade is expected to make from the win rate and the average win and loss.
tradingMetrics.formula: win rate x average win - (1 - win rate) x |average loss|

tradingMetrics.name: average_trade_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Average trade
tradingMetrics.definition: The mean net of a closed trade.

tradingMetrics.name: average_win_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Average win
tradingMetrics.definition: The mean net of a winning trade.

tradingMetrics.name: average_loss_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Average loss
tradingMetrics.definition: The mean net of a losing trade (negative).

tradingMetrics.name: largest_win_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Largest win
tradingMetrics.definition: The best closed trade.

tradingMetrics.name: largest_loss_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Largest loss
tradingMetrics.definition: The worst closed trade.

tradingMetrics.name: gross_profit_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Sum of winners
tradingMetrics.definition: The winning trades' nets added up.

tradingMetrics.name: gross_loss_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Sum of losers
tradingMetrics.definition: The losing trades' nets added up (negative).

tradingMetrics.name: trade_net_profit_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Trades' net profit
tradingMetrics.definition: The closed trades' nets added up.

tradingMetrics.name: average_bars_held
tradingMetrics.label: Average bars held
tradingMetrics.definition: How long a trade stayed open, on average.

tradingMetrics.name: average_bars_held_winners
tradingMetrics.label: Average bars held (winners)
tradingMetrics.definition: How long winning trades stayed open.

tradingMetrics.name: average_bars_held_losers
tradingMetrics.label: Average bars held (losers)
tradingMetrics.definition: How long losing trades stayed open.

tradingMetrics.name: longest_winning_streak_trades
tradingMetrics.label: Longest winning streak
tradingMetrics.definition: The most winning trades in a row.

tradingMetrics.name: longest_losing_streak_trades
tradingMetrics.label: Longest losing streak
tradingMetrics.definition: The most losing trades in a row.

tradingMetrics.name: trades_per_session_day
tradingMetrics.label: Trades per session day
tradingMetrics.definition: How often the model trades.

tradingMetrics.name: system_quality_number
tradingMetrics.label: System quality number
tradingMetrics.definition: Van Tharp's measure of how steady the trade results are: the average trade over its spread, times the square root of the trade count (uncapped).

tradingMetrics.name: exposure_fraction
tradingMetrics.label: Exposure
tradingMetrics.definition: The share of bars a position was held through.

tradingMetrics.name: long_exposure_fraction
tradingMetrics.label: Long exposure
tradingMetrics.definition: The share of bars held long.

tradingMetrics.name: short_exposure_fraction
tradingMetrics.label: Short exposure
tradingMetrics.definition: The share of bars held short.

tradingMetrics.name: flat_fraction
tradingMetrics.label: Flat

tradingMetrics.label: Total cost

tradingMetrics.label: Cost per trade

tradingMetrics.name: cost_per_contract_per_side_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Cost per contract per side

tradingMetrics.label: Costs' share of the pre-cost profit

tradingMetrics.label: Net profit

tradingMetrics.name: net_profit_before_costs_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Net profit before costs
tradingMetrics.definition: What the calls earned before commissions, fees and slippage.

tradingMetrics.name: annualized_net_profit_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Annualized net profit
tradingMetrics.definition: The average bar's net profit scaled to a year of bars.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(per-bar net) x bars per year

tradingMetrics.name: net_profit_per_session_day_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Net profit per session day
tradingMetrics.definition: Net profit divided by the session days traded.

tradingMetrics.name: average_bar_net_profit_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Average bar net profit
tradingMetrics.definition: The mean net profit of one bar.

tradingMetrics.name: bar_count
tradingMetrics.label: Bars
tradingMetrics.definition: Bars marked to market in this scope.

tradingMetrics.name: session_day_count
tradingMetrics.label: Session days
tradingMetrics.definition: CME session days with at least one bar in this scope.

tradingMetrics.name: sharpe_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Sharpe ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Average per-bar profit over its standard deviation, annualized with the run's measured bars per year.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(r) / std(r, ddof 1) x sqrt(bars per year)

tradingMetrics.name: sortino_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Sortino ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Like Sharpe, but only losing bars count as risk.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(r) / sqrt(mean(min(r, 0)^2)) x sqrt(bars per year)

tradingMetrics.name: calmar_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Calmar ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Annualized profit over the worst drawdown.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(r) x bars per year / maximum drawdown

tradingMetrics.name: sharpe_ratio_standard_error
tradingMetrics.label: Sharpe ratio standard error
tradingMetrics.definition: How uncertain the Sharpe estimate is given the sample size and the skew and fat tails of per-bar profit (Lo 2002; Bailey and Lopez de Prado 2012).
tradingMetrics.formula: sqrt((1 - skew x SR + (kurtosis - 1) / 4 x SR^2) / (N - 1)) x sqrt(bars per year), SR per bar, kurtosis not excess

tradingMetrics.name: probabilistic_sharpe_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Probabilistic Sharpe ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: The probability that the true Sharpe ratio is above zero given this sample, its skew and its fat tails (Bailey and Lopez de Prado 2012).
tradingMetrics.formula: Phi(SR x sqrt(N - 1) / sqrt(1 - skew x SR + (kurtosis - 1) / 4 x SR^2)), SR per bar

tradingMetrics.name: session_day_sharpe_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Session-day Sharpe ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Sharpe computed on each session day's net profit, annualized with 252 sessions per year.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(day net) / std(day net, ddof 1) x sqrt(252)

tradingMetrics.name: tail_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Tail ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: The size of the 95th-percentile bar gain over the 5th-percentile bar loss; above 1 the right tail is fatter.
tradingMetrics.formula: |95th percentile of r| / |5th percentile of r|

tradingMetrics.name: common_sense_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Common sense ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Profit factor times tail ratio (Kestner): above 1 the edge survives its tails.

tradingMetrics.name: recovery_factor
tradingMetrics.label: Recovery factor
tradingMetrics.definition: Net profit over the worst drawdown: how many times the profit covers its deepest hole.

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Maximum drawdown
tradingMetrics.definition: The largest fall of the equity curve (starting at 0) from a peak to a later trough.
tradingMetrics.formula: max over bars of (running peak - equity)

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_duration_bars
tradingMetrics.label: Longest drawdown (bars)
tradingMetrics.definition: The longest stretch the equity spent below a previous peak, from the peak until it was regained or the scope ended.
tradingMetrics.formula: max over drawdown episodes of bars from peak to recovery

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_duration_days
tradingMetrics.label: Longest drawdown (days)
tradingMetrics.definition: The same stretch in calendar days.
tradingMetrics.formula: time from peak to recovery / 86,400 s

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_recovery_bars
tradingMetrics.label: Recovery from the maximum drawdown (bars)
tradingMetrics.note: the scope ended before the equity regained its peak
tradingMetrics.definition: Bars from the deepest trough back to the peak before it; null when the scope ended before the equity recovered.
tradingMetrics.formula: bars from trough to recovery of the deepest episode

tradingMetrics.name: average_drawdown_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Average drawdown
tradingMetrics.definition: The average depth below the running peak over the bars spent under water.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(running peak - equity) over bars below the peak

tradingMetrics.name: ulcer_index_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Ulcer index
tradingMetrics.definition: The root mean square depth below the running peak over every bar: depth and duration of pain together (Martin and McCann 1989, in USD).

tradingMetrics.name: drawdown_count
tradingMetrics.label: Drawdowns
tradingMetrics.definition: Distinct peak-to-trough-to-recovery episodes.

tradingMetrics.label: System quality number

tradingMetrics.name: cost_per_trade_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Cost per trade
tradingMetrics.definition: The round-trip cost of a trade, on average.

tradingMetrics.name: cost_per_contract_per_side_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Cost per contract per side
tradingMetrics.definition: What one contract costs to enter or exit once.
tradingMetrics.formula: median over trades of cost / (2 x contracts)

tradingMetrics.name: cost_share_of_net_profit_before_costs
tradingMetrics.label: Costs' share of the pre-cost profit
tradingMetrics.note: the calls earned nothing before costs
tradingMetrics.definition: How much of what the calls earned went to costs; above 1 the costs took more than the edge.
tradingMetrics.formula: total cost / net profit before costs

tradingMetrics.name: break_even_cost_per_contract_per_side_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Break-even cost per contract per side
tradingMetrics.definition: The cost per contract per side at which the net profit would be zero: the cushion the edge has against costs.
tradingMetrics.formula: cost per contract per side + net profit / (2 x contracts traded)

tradingMetrics.name: buy_and_hold_net_profit_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Buy and hold
tradingMetrics.definition: One contract position bought at each fold's first open and sold at its last close, one round trip per fold, summed.
tradingMetrics.formula: sum over folds of (last close - first open) x point value x contracts - one round trip

tradingMetrics.name: net_profit_minus_buy_and_hold_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Net profit minus buy and hold
tradingMetrics.definition: How much the model made beyond holding the market.

tradingMetrics.label: Net profit

tradingMetrics.name: net_profit_before_costs_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Net profit before costs
tradingMetrics.definition: What the calls earned before commissions, fees and slippage.

tradingMetrics.name: annualized_net_profit_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Annualized net profit
tradingMetrics.definition: The average bar's net profit scaled to a year of bars.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(per-bar net) x bars per year

tradingMetrics.name: net_profit_per_session_day_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Net profit per session day
tradingMetrics.definition: Net profit divided by the session days traded.

tradingMetrics.label: Average bar net profit
tradingMetrics.definition: The mean net profit of one bar.

tradingMetrics.label: Bars
tradingMetrics.definition: Bars marked to market in this scope.

tradingMetrics.name: session_day_count
tradingMetrics.label: Session days
tradingMetrics.definition: CME session days with at least one bar in this scope.

tradingMetrics.name: sharpe_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Sharpe ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Average per-bar profit over its standard deviation, annualized with the run's measured bars per year.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(r) / std(r, ddof 1) x sqrt(bars per year)

tradingMetrics.name: sortino_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Sortino ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Like Sharpe, but only losing bars count as risk.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(r) / sqrt(mean(min(r, 0)^2)) x sqrt(bars per year)

tradingMetrics.name: calmar_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Calmar ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Annualized profit over the worst drawdown.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(r) x bars per year / maximum drawdown

tradingMetrics.name: sharpe_ratio_standard_error
tradingMetrics.label: Sharpe ratio standard error
tradingMetrics.definition: How uncertain the Sharpe estimate is given the sample size and the skew and fat tails of per-bar profit (Lo 2002; Bailey and Lopez de Prado 2012).
tradingMetrics.formula: sqrt((1 - skew x SR + (kurtosis - 1) / 4 x SR^2) / (N - 1)) x sqrt(bars per year), SR per bar, kurtosis not excess

tradingMetrics.name: probabilistic_sharpe_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Probabilistic Sharpe ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: The probability that the true Sharpe ratio is above zero given this sample, its skew and its fat tails (Bailey and Lopez de Prado 2012).
tradingMetrics.formula: Phi(SR x sqrt(N - 1) / sqrt(1 - skew x SR + (kurtosis - 1) / 4 x SR^2)), SR per bar

tradingMetrics.name: session_day_sharpe_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Session-day Sharpe ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Sharpe computed on each session day's net profit, annualized with 252 sessions per year.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(day net) / std(day net, ddof 1) x sqrt(252)

tradingMetrics.name: tail_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Tail ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: The size of the 95th-percentile bar gain over the 5th-percentile bar loss; above 1 the right tail is fatter.
tradingMetrics.formula: |95th percentile of r| / |5th percentile of r|

tradingMetrics.name: common_sense_ratio
tradingMetrics.label: Common sense ratio
tradingMetrics.definition: Profit factor times tail ratio (Kestner): above 1 the edge survives its tails.

tradingMetrics.name: recovery_factor
tradingMetrics.label: Recovery factor
tradingMetrics.definition: Net profit over the worst drawdown: how many times the profit covers its deepest hole.

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Maximum drawdown
tradingMetrics.definition: The largest fall of the equity curve (starting at 0) from a peak to a later trough.
tradingMetrics.formula: max over bars of (running peak - equity)

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_duration_bars
tradingMetrics.label: Longest drawdown (bars)
tradingMetrics.definition: The longest stretch the equity spent below a previous peak, from the peak until it was regained or the scope ended.
tradingMetrics.formula: max over drawdown episodes of bars from peak to recovery

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_duration_days
tradingMetrics.label: Longest drawdown (days)
tradingMetrics.definition: The same stretch in calendar days.
tradingMetrics.formula: time from peak to recovery / 86,400 s

tradingMetrics.name: maximum_drawdown_recovery_bars
tradingMetrics.label: Recovery from the maximum drawdown (bars)
tradingMetrics.note: the scope ended before the equity regained its peak
tradingMetrics.definition: Bars from the deepest trough back to the peak before it; null when the scope ended before the equity recovered.
tradingMetrics.formula: bars from trough to recovery of the deepest episode

tradingMetrics.name: average_drawdown_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Average drawdown
tradingMetrics.definition: The average depth below the running peak over the bars spent under water.
tradingMetrics.formula: mean(running peak - equity) over bars below the peak

tradingMetrics.name: ulcer_index_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Ulcer index
tradingMetrics.definition: The root mean square depth below the running peak over every bar: depth and duration of pain together (Martin and McCann 1989, in USD).

tradingMetrics.name: drawdown_count
tradingMetrics.label: Drawdowns
tradingMetrics.definition: Distinct peak-to-trough-to-recovery episodes.

tradingMetrics.label: System quality number
tradingMetrics.definition: Van Tharp's measure of how steady the trade results are: the average trade over its spread, times the square root of the trade count (uncapped).

tradingMetrics.name: cost_per_trade_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Cost per trade
tradingMetrics.definition: The round-trip cost of a trade, on average.

tradingMetrics.name: cost_per_contract_per_side_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Cost per contract per side
tradingMetrics.definition: What one contract costs to enter or exit once.
tradingMetrics.formula: median over trades of cost / (2 x contracts)

tradingMetrics.name: cost_share_of_net_profit_before_costs
tradingMetrics.label: Costs' share of the pre-cost profit
tradingMetrics.note: the calls earned nothing before costs
tradingMetrics.definition: How much of what the calls earned went to costs; above 1 the costs took more than the edge.
tradingMetrics.formula: total cost / net profit before costs

tradingMetrics.name: break_even_cost_per_contract_per_side_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Break-even cost per contract per side
tradingMetrics.definition: The cost per contract per side at which the net profit would be zero: the cushion the edge has against costs.
tradingMetrics.formula: cost per contract per side + net profit / (2 x contracts traded)

tradingMetrics.name: buy_and_hold_net_profit_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Buy and hold
tradingMetrics.definition: One contract position bought at each fold's first open and sold at its last close, one round trip per fold, summed.
tradingMetrics.formula: sum over folds of (last close - first open) x point value x contracts - one round trip

tradingMetrics.name: net_profit_minus_buy_and_hold_usd
tradingMetrics.label: Net profit minus buy and hold
tradingMetrics.definition: How much the model made beyond holding the market.
